task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A close-up laparoscopic view displays a field of yellowish-orange adipose tissue, likely omentum or mesentery, characterized by a dense, branching network of fine red and pink blood vessels. On the left side of the frame, a distinct, pale pinkish-white linear fold or band of tissue runs vertically. The right side of the image is partially obscured by a blurry, out-of-focus white and pinkish mass, possibly a surgical instrument tip or adjacent tissue, which creates a hazy foreground element. A small, circular icon containing a lightbulb symbol is visible in the top right corner, and the text "NOVADQ" appears in the bottom right corner. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the texture and vascularity of the tissue surface.
